tei:div.tei:p: mchod brjod dang rtsom pa dam bca' ba/

bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi rgyal po skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i sku/ /chos kyi dbang phyug khams gsum 'dren pa'i mchog /chos kyi 'byor pas stong gsum dbul ba sel/ /chos rje bla ma dus gsum mkhyen la 'dud/ /bskal bzang 'di la srid pa gsum gyi mgon/ /mtshan bzang dpe byad brgyad cu'i gzi 'od 'bar/ /rigs bzang zas gtsang sras po lha'i lha/ /blo bzang kun mkhyen rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud// byams pa'i thugs kyis log pa'i lta ba 'joms/ /snyan dbyangs gsung gi 'gro la chos char 'bebs/ /smra ba'i phyogs la mi 'jigs seng ge yi/ /spobs pa mchog stsaul rgyal sras sku la 'dud/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas phyir ston pa yis/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang*/ /bstan la gnod byed dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /bstan srung lha chen dpal 'bar rgyal gyur cig/ de ltar mchod par brjod nas/ dam pa rnams dgyes pa'i 'bel gtam mkhas rmongs dbye ba'i gzhi/ /rgya gar rgya nag ge sar stag gzig dang*/ /bal po hor sog mi nyag rgyal rabs dang*/ khyad par bod yul gangs can khrod 'di ru// bstan pa'i gsal byed lo paṇa khu dbon sogs// mkhas grub du mas dka' ba brgya phrag gis/ /dge 'dun sde btsugs bshad sgrub bskyangs tshul dang*/ /de'i sbyin bdag sde dpon byams ldan rnams/ /rim par byon nas bstan pa'i bya ba dang*/ /rang gzhan phan bde'i dpal la bkod tshul gyi/ /yig tshang ngo mtshar 'phreng ba mtha' yas rnams/ /bdag rmongs blo yis srad bur brgyus la nus// 'on kyang bstan la gus zhing mkhas pa yi/ /phyag srol mthong la blo mos che ba dang*/ /gong ma'i rnam thar dam pa'i gleng 'os rnams/ /brjed du phangs nas sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dir/ /byon pa'i tshul dang bka' chems bka' khol dang*/ /rgyal rabs rkyang khugs blon po'i zhal gdams dang*/ /sba bzhed yar lung jo bo tshal pa dang*/

/bu ston gyis mdzad chos 'byung chen mo sogs/ /yig tshang sna tshogs legs bsdus brjed byang dang*// blo gsal mdzes pa'i rgyan la phan phyir du/ /mdor bsdus don gsal 'di nyid bdag gis bris/ /mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis bzod pa mdzad par rigs/ /rgya bod kyi yig tshang mkhas pa dga' bar byed pa'i mchod brjod dang gleng gzhi bstan pa phyogs dus thams cad du dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/ PAGE 3 mchod brjod dang rtsom pa dam bca'/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 3--PAGE 1-
